# mysuite

> Local, offline CLI toolbox for quick image/logo jobs (export, convert, cutout, watermark, metadata, compress, enhance). Every command supports --json.

- [Agent guide](AGENTS.md): rules, which command to use, examples, exit codes
- [Command reference](docs/agents/COMMANDS.md): every option, generated from the CLI
- [README](README.md): install, tools, status and honest limits
- [Roadmap](docs/ROADMAP.md)
- Run `mysuite schema` for a machine-readable description of all commands and the result format
